states.2:
// coding-misk · Ten Years · ricostruzione
// song composed with sections and tracks: each track plays its clips, switched on by the section lane (1 plays, 0 is silent, values in between fade)
// each .analyze("…") lights up its instrument in the Stage visual
setcpm(92/4)

const SECTIONS = [['Crescendo', 31], ['Crescendo 2', 53], ['Intro', 8], ['Strofa A', 9], ['Swoosh', 1], ['Strofa B', 8], ['Breakdown', 6], ['Riser', 2], ['Finale', 20], ['Outro', 3], ['Strip', 2]]
const TEMPO = {'Crescendo': 92, 'Crescendo 2': 92, 'Intro': 92, 'Strofa A': 92, 'Swoosh': 92, 'Strofa B': 92, 'Breakdown': 92, 'Riser': 92, 'Finale': 92, 'Outro': 92, 'Strip': 92}

// section lanes: 1 plays, 0 is silent, values in between fade
const section1 = "<1!31 0!112>"  // Crescendo · 31 bars · 92 BPM · E · Em
const section2 = "<0!31 1!53 0!59>"  // Crescendo 2 · 53 bars · 92 BPM · E · Em Em D D C C D D
const section3 = "<0!84 1!8 0!51>"  // Intro · 8 bars · 92 BPM · E · Em Em D D
const section4 = "<0!92 1!9 0!42>"  // Strofa A · 9 bars · 92 BPM · E · Em Em D D C C D D
const section5 = "<0!101 1 0!41>"  // Swoosh · 1 bars · 92 BPM · E · Em Em D D C C D D
const section6 = "<0!102 1!8 0.67 0.33 0!31>"  // Strofa B · 8 bars · 92 BPM · E · Em Em D D C C D D
const section7 = "<0!110 0.33 0.67 1!4 0!27>"  // Breakdown · 6 bars · 92 BPM · E · Em Em D D · fades in over 2 bars
const section8 = "<0!116 1!2 0!25>"  // Riser · 2 bars · 92 BPM · E · Em Em D D
const section9 = "<0!118 1!20 0!5>"  // Finale · 20 bars · 92 BPM · E · Em Em D D C C D D
const section10 = "<0!138 1!3 0!2>"  // Outro · 3 bars · 92 BPM · E · Em Em D D
const section11 = "<0!141 1!2>"  // Strip · 2 bars · 92 BPM · E · Em Em D D

// ========== drums ==========
// Crescendo · bars 1-31 · pattern A~3
// Drums · RolandTR909
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.68).lpf(2000).mask(section1).velocity(section1).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ ~ ~ [cp ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.54).lpf(2000).mask(section1).velocity(section1).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.34).lpf(2000).mask(section1).velocity(section1).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
// Crescendo 2 · bars 32-84 · pattern A~3
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.68).lpf(2000).mask(section2).velocity(section2).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ ~ ~ [cp ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.54).lpf(2000).mask(section2).velocity(section2).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.34).lpf(2000).mask(section2).velocity(section2).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
// Strofa A · bars 93-101 · pattern A~3
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.68).lpf(2000).mask(section4).velocity(section4).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ ~ ~ [cp ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.54).lpf(2000).mask(section4).velocity(section4).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.34).lpf(2000).mask(section4).velocity(section4).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
$: s("sd*16").bank("RolandTR909").gain(saw.range(.15, .75)).mask("<0 1 0!7>").mask(section4).velocity(section4).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("cr").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.55).room(.4).mask("<0!2 1 0!6>").mask(section4).velocity(section4).orbit(1).analyze("fx")
// Strofa B · bars 103-110 · pattern A~3
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.68).lpf(2000).mask(section6).velocity(section6).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ ~ ~ [cp ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.54).lpf(2000).mask(section6).velocity(section6).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.34).lpf(2000).mask(section6).velocity(section6).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
$: s("cr").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.55).room(.4).mask("<0!6 1 0>").mask(section6).velocity(section6).orbit(1).analyze("fx")
// Riser · bars 117-118 · pattern B~3
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] [hh ~ ~ ~] [hh ~ ~ ~] [hh ~ hh ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.34).lpf(2000).mask("<1 [1 0]>").mask(section8).velocity(section8).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
$: s("sd*16").bank("RolandTR909").gain(saw.range(.15, .75)).mask("<0 1>").mask(section8).velocity(section8).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
// Finale · bars 119-138 · pattern C~3
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.68).lpf(2000).mask(section9).velocity(section9).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ [cp ~ ~ ~] ~ [cp ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.54).lpf(2000).mask(section9).velocity(section9).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.34).lpf(2000).mask(section9).velocity(section9).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
$: s("sd*16").bank("RolandTR909").gain(saw.range(.15, .75)).mask("<0!17 1 0!2>").mask(section9).velocity(section9).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("cr").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.55).room(.4).mask("<0!18 1 0>").mask(section9).velocity(section9).orbit(1).analyze("fx")
